summary: Tested the NEW legacy-ERP-portal (Radish/MS SQL) Delivery Challan sync layered on the live SAP Stock Transfer Order flow. Backend: new pytest file (15 tests, all pass) covering live MS SQL connectivity + primary/fallback failover + stored-proc existence (read-only, no inserts), full field-mapping verification of stock_transfer_service.sync_to_erp_portal via a fake portal client (CompCode RI for P1/P8, RT for P2/P9/P3, Pcode = ship-to site, Rate/Amt/Amount/TaxableAmt = SAP Moving Average x qty, HSN + Trans/Emp_no/ElecRefNo/Padd_Code1-2/Term1-3 blank, tdis_amt 0), mark_erp_portal_failed, not-found handling, and the API surface (erp_portal_status/erp_portal_error/erp_sale_no/erp_sale_noc exposed on list + detail, no _id leak, auth gated). Frontend: created one real live order end-to-end via the UI (STO-000035, P8 -> P1, product P27175, Vehicle TESTQA1150 / GR TESTQA-GR-115) - 5-step progress bar renders in exact order validate/check/create/erp_sync/post_goods_issue, dialog ERP box went 'Syncing to ERP Portal...' -> green 'Synced to ERP Portal (Delivery Challan created).' in ~25s, backend confirmed erp_portal_status=synced, erp_sale_no=38078, erp_sale_noc=1, GI posted independently, GST Recorded. After reload the Recent Orders 'ERP Portal' column shows Synced (green) / Pending (amber) and the detail modal shows 'Portal Sale No: 38078 / 1' above the Goods Issue box. Regressions checked: retry-GI button on GI-failed order, GST badge, greyed-out non-usable warehouse options, AI Quick Entry parse+apply auto-picking source warehouse - all working.

minor.issue: When the SAP valuation lookup returns nothing (observed live: sap_valuation_client logged repeated ConnectTimeout to the SAP tenant at 18:46-18:49), rate silently falls back to 0.0 and the challan is still inserted and marked erp_portal_status='synced' - a live portal row with Rate/Amt/Amount/TaxableAmt = 0 and no error surfaced anywhere. Insert-only client means it cannot be corrected.

No idempotency guard - sync_to_erp_portal does not skip docs already erp_portal_status='synced', so any future retry/re-run path would insert a duplicate Delivery Challan (no delete capability by design).

ui_bugs.component: StockTransferPage - detail modal / Recent Orders ERP column
ui_bugs.issue: Orders created BEFORE this feature (erp_portal_status null, e.g. STO-000030) show 'ERP Portal: syncing...' forever in the detail modal and an amber 'Pending' badge in the table - misleading, they will never sync. Needs a distinct 'Not synced / N/A' state for null status on already-final orders.

Repeated React error 'Encountered two children with the same key' on this page (duplicate keys in the source-warehouse / ship-to-location option lists - e.g. two 'P1 - RETURN TO VENDOR GODOWN-P1' rows). Can cause duplicated/omitted options.

integration_issues.flow: Order creation -> Recent Orders / detail modal ERP status
integration_issues.issue: Right after creation the confirm dialog correctly shows 'Synced to ERP Portal', but the Recent Orders row still shows 'Pending' and the detail modal shows 'ERP Portal: syncing...'. loadRecentOrders() is only called on SAP-done and on GI terminal state, and closing the dialog sets giPollStopRef=true which kills the poll - so the table/detail stay stale until a manual page reload (verified: after reload both show Synced correctly). Fix: call loadRecentOrders() when erp_portal_status transitions to synced/failed, and/or re-fetch GET /orders/{id} when the detail modal opens instead of reusing the stale list row.

issues: No manual 'Retry ERP Portal sync' control for erp_portal_status='failed' orders, unlike Goods Issue which has a retry button - a failed challan is currently unrecoverable from the UI.

action_items: Refresh Recent Orders / detail modal when ERP sync completes (currently stale 'Pending'/'syncing...' until manual reload)
Distinguish null erp_portal_status on pre-feature/final orders from an in-flight sync ('Not synced' instead of 'syncing...')
Do not mark erp_portal_status='synced' when the SAP Moving Average price could not be fetched (writes Rate/Amt=0 into the live portal silently) - fail or flag it instead
Add an idempotency guard (skip if already synced) before calling create_delivery_challan
Consider a manual 'Retry ERP Portal sync' button for failed syncs
Fix duplicate React keys in the warehouse/location option lists
critical_code_review_comments: stock_transfer_service.sync_to_erp_portal: `rate = cost['amount'] if cost else 0.0` silently produces a zero-value Delivery Challan on SAP valuation failure/timeout; the sync is then reported as fully successful. Given the portal client is insert-only, prefer raising so the doc is marked failed and can be retried.

erp_portal_client.create_delivery_challan: conn.close() without an explicit rollback in the except path - pytds rolls back on close for a non-committed tx, but an explicit conn.rollback() would make the transactional intent unambiguous.
No de-dup/idempotency key on the portal side: a second invocation of _run_erp_portal_sync_job for the same sto_id creates a second challan.

rca_of_the_issue: Stale ERP status in Recent Orders/detail modal: pollGiStatus() updates only local erpLiveStatus + stepStatuses; loadRecentOrders() runs on SAP-done and on GI terminal state only, and the dialog Close button sets giPollStopRef.current=true which ends the poll, so no refetch happens after ERP sync completes. The detail modal renders the stale list row object (setSelectedOrder(o)) with no per-order refetch. Backend data was verified correct via GET /api/stock-transfer/orders/STO-000035 (erp_portal_status='synced', erp_sale_no=38078, erp_sale_noc=1) and correct after a manual page reload - purely a frontend refresh gap.
